What does it take to build a winning Formula 1 team?
Audi Racing Director Allan McNish opens up about the team's journey, the one thing money can't buy in F1, and what it takes to build the right attitude and culture within a team.
He also discusses race-day decisions, lessons from Formula E, Audi's ambitions for 2030, and shares three valuable tips for young Indian racers hoping to make it to Formula 1.
Plus, could we see the Indian Grand Prix return to the F1 calendar? Allan shares his thoughts.
